distributed secondary frequency regulation and droop control are equivalent and that the optimal steady state of the economic dispatch is the steady state of the droop-controlled system.

(1) the economic dispatch problem can be solved using droop control; (2) the economic dispatch solution can be computed using distributed averaging-based controllers; and (3) the distributed averaging-based controllers achieve the same performance as the centralized controllers.
